# codx-api

> codx-api is a Python FastAPI backend exposing all functionalities for codx-junior.

## Documentation

- [Welcome to the codx-junior Wiki](home): This wiki serves as a concise, endpoint-centric reference for the codx-junior project, documenting core architecture, API endpoints, routing configuration, and middleware generation for external-facing services.
